title: 3.10 Introduction Mission
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to give a name and limited age/origin/job information and describe simple possession.

grammar_function: Integrated name, age within 1-20, origin, nationality, profession, possessives, and have/has.
speaking_outcome: Deliver six model-supported mission utterances: greeting/name, age, origin, job, possession, and third-person possession.
